name: The VA XC Showcase
where: Mechanicsville, VA · host Hanover · Pole Green Park
headline: The VA XC Showcase
summary: Final: Boys Showcase: No. 1 Christ School won with 26 points, ahead of No. 26 Calvert Hall (MD) (66) and Cardinal Gibbons and Cuthbertson (154 each), and South Eugene's Yosuke Shibata won in 14:53.7. Girls Showcase: No. 1 Union Catholic (NJ) scored 65 to beat Penn Charter (132), Blacksburg (154) and Marvin Ridge (183), with Georgetown Visitation eighth (283) and James Robinson tenth (322), and Peters Township's Kathryn Froelich won in 16:53.9.
